description: Every website app capture: how to retake it and which application files drive it. Checked by scripts/check-capture-catalogue.mjs.

browser.note: 1440 x 683, the size of the published classic dashboard frames and the width behind the 1232 px element frames (user decision 1 October 2026).

framingTypes.element: The bounding box of target (plus padding CSS px). target.heading means the section containing that heading; through extends the box to a second target.
framingTypes.crop: Take a full-page frame of source, then crop to target's box. target.subPanel is [data-sub-panel=<id>]. legacyRect is the fixed rectangle used before (1600 px frames, left 260, width 1335 unless given); reference only.
framingTypes.scroll-compose: Three viewport frames of container composed with npm run captures:compose.
framingTypes.full-page: A full-page frame, used only as a crop source.

live.playback: Needs live sessions: start muted playback in a local test media app first and stop it after, then pass --live=playback.
live.dismissed-up-next: Needs a dismissed Up Next item: the script dismisses one, captures, then adds that one back.
live.manual-review-item: Needs a pending Manual Watch review item: mark an episode played in a local test media app if none is waiting, then pass --live=manual-review-item.
live.sync-issue: Needs at least one current sync issue.

dashboard.state: Dashboard at scroll top. Now Playing / Up Next panel, the Up Next rail and the first history rows loaded with posters. Dashboard history rows in full-card mode (Posters only off). Capture at 1396x950: four complete cards per rail and portrait poster areas; do not reuse the short 683px frame.

now-playing.state: Dashboard with a live Plex playback session and the updated Now Playing panel.

now-playing-options.state: Dashboard with a live playback session; the cog beside the Now Playing panel heading is open. Change nothing; close the options afterwards.

dashboard-up-next.state: Featured Up Next cards, including the heading, resume progress and Watch now links.

dashboard-up-next-dismissed.state: Open Dismissed Up Next with at least two dismissed shows, so Add back and Add all back are visible. The operator restores only the two temporary items individually after capture; never press Add all back.

dashboard-history-tv.state: Dashboard; the Recently watched TV Shows row in full-card mode, scrolled into view. Capture at 1396x950: four complete cards per rail and portrait poster areas; do not reuse the short 683px frame.

dashboard-history-movies.state: Dashboard; the Recently watched Movies row in full-card mode, scrolled into view. Capture at 1396x950: four complete cards per rail and portrait poster areas; do not reuse the short 683px frame.

global-search.state: Open Global Search from the Dashboard sidebar and search for Ted Lasso; wait for TMDB and TheTVDB groups.

appearance-dashboard.state: The sidebar Appearance panel open, showing the Light and Dark toggle, the Card Art and Background Art switches, and the Text size slider.

movies.state: Movies library at scroll top, default card view, posters loaded. Do not change filters.

tvshows.state: TV Shows library at scroll top, default card view (Posters only off), posters loaded.

library-poster-menu.state: Movies library; open the three-dot quick-actions menu on the first poster card. Change nothing.

history.state: History page at scroll top, default card view, cards loaded.

history-days.state: Watch History in Days view, with the first day group, item count and cards loaded.

upcoming.state: Upcoming calendar; the complete current month, from its heading through the final week. The tall viewport keeps every calendar row and poster inside the frame.

discover.state: Discover at scroll top, feeds loaded with posters.

stats.state: Stats at scroll top with its media type, period and range controls visible.

watchlist.state: Watchlist at scroll top, cards loaded.

watchlist-card.state: Watchlist; the first row of cards with posters, rating actions and remove controls.

ratings-cards.state: Ratings; the Movies, TV Shows and Episodes groups.

ratings-episode-focus.state: Ratings; the Episodes group scrolled into view.

playlists.state: Playlists at scroll top; the headings, app badges, item counts, and first three complete cards in each of the four rails.

playlists-cards.state: Playlists; the first playlist's cards showing the Move pill.

sync-activity-focused.state: Sync Activity at scroll top, rows loaded with sources, destinations and outcomes.

sync-activity-issues-focused.state: Classic only. Sync Activity with the Issues only filter on; current issues and failed groups visible.

movie-detail-page.state: Movie detail for A Quiet Place, every section loaded (cast, images, trailers, collection, recommendations).

media-header.state: Movie detail at scroll top; header with poster, title, synopsis, facts, ratings and availability.

media-detail-overview.state: Movie detail; the action bar with Hide Spoilers, Force Sync, watch state, artwork, match, merge, delete and info controls.

media-action-row.state: TV show detail for Lioness; watchlist, custom-list, Drop, Up Next and options action row.

media-watch-status.state: Movie detail; the Watch Status section with watched date and completion percentage.

media-rating-focus.state: Movie detail; media facts with a personal rating beside provider ratings.

media-cast-focus.state: Movie detail; the Cast section scrolled into view.

media-trailers-focus.state: Movie detail; the Trailers and Clips section.

media-collections-recommendations-focus.state: Movie detail; the collection row and the recommended movie row together.

media-sections.state: Classic only. Movie detail; the section area as used by the media-page guides.

media-appearance.state: Movie detail with the Appearance menu open showing the section switches. Change nothing.

media-tools-focus.state: Movie detail; the Options menu open (Mark unwatched, Force Sync, Info, Edit Images, Fix Match, Delete). Press nothing in it.

media-info-focus.state: Movie detail; Options, Info: the Info panel open with watch status, latest watched date, sync results and audit details.

media-edit-images-focus.state: Edit Images open with Poster, Season Posters, Logo, Background and YouTube Show tabs. Frame the tabs and first complete artwork row, ending before the next row; choose/save nothing.

fix-match.state: Movie detail; Fix Match open with a search across all sources, result cards and the YouTube fallback. Apply nothing.

fix-match-focus.state: Same state as fix-match, cropped to the dialog.

tv-detail-page.state: Show detail for Lioness, every section loaded (header, progress, seasons, cast, images, trailers). Use 1373px width so Related Shows ends after eleven complete cards; compose the entire scrollable page without resizing.

tv-trailers-focus.state: Show detail; Trailers and Clips with four populated video cards.

tv-related-focus.state: Show detail; a populated Related Shows rail.

tv-seasons-episodes-focus.state: Show detail with the Season 3 accordion open: episode cards, watched state, release dates and episode actions. Capture the complete season-card column and episode panel; no season poster or episode card may be clipped.

tv-media-info-focus.state: The War Between the Land and the Sea detail; Options, Info: the Info panel open with watched episodes, destination results and audit events.

tv-spoilers-off.state: Bridgerton detail with Season 3 expanded (5 of 8 episodes watched) and Hide Spoilers unchecked. Capture the complete season-card column and episode panel; no season poster or episode card may be clipped.

tv-spoilers-on.state: Bridgerton detail with Season 3 expanded (5 of 8 episodes watched) and Hide Spoilers checked, hiding unwatched artwork and synopses. Capture the complete season-card column and episode panel; no season poster or episode card may be clipped.

settings-about.state: About page with the installed version and project links.

settings-general-account.state: Settings general page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-general-integrity.state: Settings general page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-general-storage-cache.state: Settings general page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-media-servers-focused.state: Media servers page with the Plex, Emby and Jellyfin cards.

settings-media-servers-plex.state: Settings media-servers page; the Plex connection card and its help panel.

settings-media-servers-emby.state: Settings media-servers page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-media-servers-jellyfin.state: Settings media-servers page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-webhooks-setup.state: Settings webhooks page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-webhooks-secret.state: Settings webhooks page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-connections-trakt.state: Settings connections page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-connections-tautulli.state: Settings connections page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-connections-seerr.state: Settings connections page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-metadata-providers.state: Settings metadata page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-metadata-refresh.state: Settings metadata page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-metadata-refresh-tmdb.state: Settings metadata page; the TMDB refresh row expanded, with its refresh button visible. Do not run the refresh.

settings-metadata-refresh-tvdb.state: Settings metadata page; the TVDB refresh row expanded, with its refresh button visible. Do not run the refresh.

settings-sync-overview-focused.state: Sync settings; the complete Sync Tuning card and its help panel, including the save action. Subsequent Sync Tools cards are outside this frame.

settings-sync-tuning.state: Settings sync page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-sync-tools.state: Settings sync page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-backup-local.state: Settings backup page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-backup-remote.state: Settings backup page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-restore-focused.state: Restore page at scroll top with local watch-history and full-backup sources.

settings-restore-merge-replace.state: Local Watch History Restore expanded with stored backups and Merge into existing state / Replace existing state choices. Restore nothing.

settings-restore-watch-history.state: Restore page with the Local Watch History Restore accordion (details#local-watch-history-restore) open, so the backup rows and the Merge or Replace choice show. Change and restore nothing.

settings-tools-database-repairs.state: Settings tools page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-tools-library-rebuilds.state: Settings tools page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-tools-wipe-data.state: Settings tools page at scroll top; section panels loaded.

settings-tools-guided-setup.state: Tools top bar with its Reopen Onboarding control; do not open or change setup.
